shellCommands.command: find /workspace -type f -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/.git/*' -not -path '*/.next/*' | sort
cat node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls node_modules/.bin 2>/dev/null | head -20; git diff package.json
git rm -r --quiet pages components/AppProvider.js && git status --short && ls
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -30
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -60

npm run start > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &
sleep 6
echo "--- / ---"; curl -s localhost:3000 | grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>|user agent: [^<]*|og:title[^>]*' | head
echo "--- /blog/1 title+og ---"; curl -s localhost:3000/blog/1 | grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>|property="og:[^>]*' | head
echo "--- /nope status+title ---"; curl -s -o /tmp/nf.html -w '%{http_code}\n' localhost:3000/nope; grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>|404 - Page Not Found' /tmp/nf.html | head -3
echo "--- /blog/9999 (not in staticParams) ---"; curl -s -o /tmp/p.html -w '%{http_code}\n' localhost:3000/blog/9999; grep -oE '404 - Page Not Found' /tmp/p.html | head -2
echo "--- /blog/42 (on-demand valid) ---"; curl -s -o /tmp/p42.html -w '%{http_code}\n' localhost:3000/blog/42; grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/p42.html
echo "--- head links ---"; curl -s localhost:3000 | grep -oE 'fonts.googleapis.com[^"]*|rel="icon" href="[^"]*"' | head

pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
git rm -q --cached app/blog/\[id\]/loading.tsx 2>/dev/null; rm -f "app/blog/[id]/loading.tsx"
npm run build > /tmp/build2.log 2>&1; tail -5 /tmp/build2.log
npm run start > /tmp/next2.log 2>&1 &
sleep 6
echo "--- /blog/9999 ---"; curl -s -o /tmp/p.html -w '%{http_code}\n' localhost:3000/blog/9999; grep -oE '404 - Page Not Found' /tmp/p.html | head -1
echo "--- /blog/42 ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' localhost:3000/blog/42
ls "app/blog/[id]/"; pgrep -af next | head
kill 373 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -f "/workspace/app/blog/[id]/loading.tsx"; ls "/workspace/app/blog/[id]/"
npm run build > /tmp/build2.log 2>&1; tail -22 /tmp/build2.log

cat /tmp/h.txt; echo "=== [id] methods ==="; for m in GET PUT DELETE PATCH; do printf '%s -> ' "$m"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X $m localhost:3000/api/posts/7 -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}'; done; echo "=== PUT body ==="; curl -s -X PUT localhost:3000/api/posts/7 -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"New"}'; echo; curl -s -X DELETE localhost:3000/api/posts/7
git diff -- tsconfig.json; echo "=== gitignore ==="; cat .gitignore; echo "=== untracked ==="; git status --short
pgrep -f next-server | xargs -r kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; npx tsc --noEmit && echo "TSC OK"; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -22
ls -d .next 2>/dev/null; pgrep -a -f 'v16.4.0' | head
rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && npx tsc --noEmit && echo "TSC OK" && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -22

(npm run start > /tmp/final.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6
for p in / /blog /blog/1 /blog/42 /blog/9999 /nope; do printf '%-12s ' "$p"; curl -s -o /tmp/o.html -w '%{http_code}' localhost:3000$p; printf '  %s\n' "$(grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/o.html | head -1)"; done
echo "--- tsconfig diff (should be include-only) ---"; git diff --stat -- tsconfig.json
node -e 'const {execSync}=require("child_process");const l=execSync("ss -ltnp").toString().split("\n").find(x=>x.includes(":3000"));const m=l&&l.match(/pid=(\d+)/);if(m)process.kill(+m[1]);'

rm -rf /workspace/.next /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git status --short; echo "=== files ==="; find /workspace -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.css' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/__agent_eval__/*' -not -path '*/.next/*' | sort
